message: shorter items' backgrounds won't stretch in a wrapping row
hint: Wrapped items are separate inline blocks, so painted cards of different heights on one line stay ragged. Use align-items: flex-start to make that explicit.

message: % columns with a gap stop sharing a line once the row is narrower than 364px in the source, but stay side by side in the output
hint: The gap is fixed while the columns shrink with the line; use a smaller gap or percentages that leave more room.
